# grouper_group_privileges (Resource)

Sets exactly which privileges one subject has on a group. The subject's other privileges on the group are revoked, and other subjects' privileges, including any Grouper grants by default, are left alone. Use one of these per group and subject.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grouper_group_privileges" "director" {
  group         = grouper_group.members.id
  subject_group = grouper_group.director.id
  privileges    = ["update", "read"]
}

resource "grouper_group_privileges" "charlie" {
  group          = grouper_group.members.id
  subject        = "charlie"
  subject_source = "ldap"
  privileges     = ["read"]
}

# Grouper's built-in subject for everyone
resource "grouper_group_privileges" "everyone" {
  group          = grouper_group.members.id
  subject        = "GrouperAll"
  subject_source = "g:isa"
  privileges     = ["view"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) UUID of the group, such as `grouper_group.example.id`.
- `privileges` (Set of String) Privileges the subject has on the group, from `admin`, `read`, `update`, `view`, `optin`, `optout`, `groupAttrRead`, `groupAttrUpdate`.

### Optional

- `subject` (String) Subject ID of a person or other subject, such as `GrouperAll` for everyone. Requires `subject_source`. Exactly one of `subject` and `subject_group` is required.
- `subject_group` (String) UUID of a group, whose members all get the privileges. Exactly one of `subject` and `subject_group` is required.
- `subject_source` (String) Subject source of `subject`, such as `ldap`, or `g:isa` for `GrouperAll`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the group's current full name, then the subject: a subject source and subject ID, or a
# group's current full name
tofu import grouper_group_privileges.director 'org:dept:members org:dept:director'
tofu import grouper_group_privileges.charlie 'org:dept:members ldap charlie'
```
